description: This file defines the 'DocumentsViewEdit' class, which extends 'ViewEdit' to implement the editing view for document records within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for constructing the view and rendering the form with dynamic data, handling signed document loading, and setting various form parameters and related document information.

classes.name: DocumentsViewEdit
classes.description: Defines the view component for editing documents within SuiteCRM, handling form rendering, data initialization, and related document linkages.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the view, setting it to be used for subpanels.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the document edit form, populating fields based on request parameters and document relationships, and handling signed document loading.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates the module title parameters, including a link to the detailed view if the record exists.
